verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any natural-language command interface in Amplitude Experiment. The only agent-related items are an official MCP server, llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec. These are machine-readable or agent-integration building blocks that belong to separate stories, and none shows users operating Experiment through natural-language commands, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
